module: Flowgraph node "Log" (category dynamic_instant, tags util/print). Writes the received value to the game console (log) and to the graph event log (mgr:logEvent). Inputs: value (any; tables are converted by dumps), logTag (string, default "Node #<id>"), logType (I Info, D Debug, W Warning, E Error; default I). In 'repeat' dynamic mode, the message is written every frame.
usage: -- the node is equivalent to: log('I', 'Node #12', msg)

postInit.desc: Prepares the templates of the logType pin, hides logType and logTag, and sets the default tag "Node #id".

work.desc: If dynamicMode is 'repeat', writes a log entry.

createLogEntry.desc: Converts the value to text (dumps for a table), calls log(type, tag, msg) and mgr:logEvent.
